newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 aluminium output up 2.05 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 aluminium output up 2.05 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's aluminium output totalled 1.693 million tonnes from January to December 1996, up by 2.05 percent compared with 1995, the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
Aluminium production in December alone was 146,600 tonnes, the bureau said.
China's alumina output totalled 2.49 million tonnes in 1996, up by 12.08 percent from the previous year, it said.
Alumina production in December alone was 220,000 tonnes, it said. -- Beijing Newsroom (8610) 6532 1921
